decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate exchangers for HVAC sit within the firm's core plate heat exchanger competence, so it can keep reading market feedback and refining the line, even though the product was not seen on the website in 2020–2021.

The marine box cooler line rests on deep water-cooling expertise and a claimed major market share, which gives strong related knowledge and justifies continuing despite its absence from recent website observations.
As a single unit it is more exposed to portfolio consolidation, but it draws on the same marine cooling competence and service learning, so the firm can still assimilate and apply improvements.

The compact oil cooler extends existing exchanger engineering into adjacent applications where manufacturing and service know-how apply directly, so keeping it is reasonable despite limited recent visibility.
Finned tubes are a core component technology the firm understands well and can keep optimizing through in-house R&D and research cooperation, though recent non-observation adds some uncertainty.

Enhanced tubes build on the firm's heat-transfer R&D and EU project experience and feed value across the portfolio, so the absorptive-capacity logic favors keeping them despite recent non-observation.
